title: Fly Brain Visualization Stream v1 extension stream_status
x-flybrain-semantic-rules: seq strictly increases per consumer across all extension messages in a run; values are not contiguous
resync is sent to a newly connected harness immediately after its mapping with dropped_steps 0
epoch_reset is sent to every consumer right after a replacement mapping with dropped_steps 0
gap precedes the next message its consumer accepts, queued only together with it, and reports dropped_steps messages lost by that consumer since its previous gap marker
